parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object('rankings', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(r)) FROM (SELECT tk.keyword, kr.position, kr.previous_position, kr.search_volume FROM tracked_keywords tk JOIN keyword_rankings kr ON kr.keyword_id = tk.id WHERE kr.checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND tk.is_active = true ORDER BY kr.search_volume DESC LIMIT 20) r), 'backlinks', (SELECT json_build_object('total', COUNT(*), 'new_7d', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 'avg_dr', ROUND(AVG(domain_rating))) FROM backlinks WHERE is_active = true), 'health_issues', (SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(h)) FROM (SELECT url, issues FROM site_health_checks WHERE checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND jsonb_array_length(issues) > 0 LIMIT 5) h), 'top_pages_gsc', (SELECT metrics->'top_queries' FROM analytics_snapshots WHERE source = 'search_console' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)) as seo_data

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.OPENAI_MODEL || 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are an SEO expert. Respond only in valid JSON.' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }], temperature: 0.6, max_tokens: 1500 }) }}
